verses.en: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado todo aquele que teme ao Senhor e anda nos seus caminhos.
verses.en_web: Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up.> Happy is the worshipper of the Lord, who is walking in his ways.

verses.en: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.pt: Pois comerás do trabalho das tuas mãos; feliz serás, e te irá bem.
verses.en_web: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
verses.en_bbe: You will have the fruit of the work of your hands: happy will you be, and all will be well for you.

verses.en: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
verses.pt: A tua mulher será como a videira frutífera, no interior da tua casa; os teus filhos como plantas de oliveira, ao redor da tua mesa.
verses.en_web: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine, in the innermost parts of your house; your children like olive plants, around your table.
verses.en_bbe: Your wife will be like a fertile vine in the inmost parts of your house: your children will be like olive plants round your table.

verses.en: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
verses.pt: Eis que assim será abençoado o homem que teme ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: See! this is the blessing of the worshipper of the Lord.

verses.en: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.pt: De Sião o Senhor te abençoará; verás a prosperidade de Jerusalém por todos os dias da tua vida,
verses.en_web: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.en_bbe: May the Lord send you blessing out of Zion: may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

verses.en: Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children, and peace upon Israel.
verses.pt: e verás os filhos de teus filhos. A paz seja sobre Israel.
verses.en_web: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.en_bbe: May you see your children's children. Peace be on Israel.
